get_inside.text: The player will not be able to enter Iban's Temple and the elven lands until the player has spoken to King Lathas at the start of Regicide. The player's quest journal will mention about assassinating his brother if they have talked to him.
Travelling through Underground path
To go through the path, it is recommended to have a high Agility level. A Thieving level of 50 is another advantage.
These items are needed:
A rope (bring more if the Agility level is low)
A shortbow (chargebow will not work)
A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows (bring a few extras should you do so; no advantage in type)
Food to survive traps and monsters
Part 1
Checklist | * Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.

Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
Go to the north.
Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level #expr:42*2 Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
Continue going south, then east.

Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.

You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.
Pathmap | 5 | 5 | id=Underground Pass
Once past the spike traps, pull the [[Lever (Underground path, portcullis)
Part 2
Head west towards the [[Cage (Underground path, slave)
Part 3
Go past the smashed cage and pass through the [[Tunnel (Underground Pass)
Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair
After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave.
Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step.
After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins.
Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
Ascend the stairs.
If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
Heading south, cross the third walkway.
Jump over the [[Bridge (Iban's lair)

The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dangerous dungeon where armies of various gods, left over from the God Wars, fight one another to the death. Its release was announced in the Behind the Scenes of August 2007.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Prerequisites
• Navigating towards the dungeon requires having defeated Dad in the Troll Stronghold quest
• Entering the dungeon itself requires 60 Strength or 60 Agility 
• Entering each god encampment (therefore the boss rooms) has a skill requirement:
• Armadyl's Eyrie (south-west) - 70 Ranged 
• Bandos's Stronghold (north-west) - 70 Strength 
• Saradomin's Encampment (south-east) - 70 Agility 
• Zamorak's Fortress (north) - 70 Constitution 

Teleports
• Boss portal at War's Retreat - Requires killing any generals at least once and access to War's Retreat, and at least 100 total boss kills
• Combat portal at Max Guild - Requires Max Cape achievement and killing any generals at least once
• God Wars Dungeon Teleport - Requires level 61 Magic and completion of The Mighty Fall
• God wars teleport tablet - Requires completion of The Mighty Fall
• Trollheim Teleport - Standard spells, requires level 61 Magic and completion of Eadgar's Ruse
• Trollheim tablet - Requires completed Love Story and taken the miner's diary to the Wise Old Man
• Trollheim Farm Teleport - Lunar spells, requires level 92 Magic, completion of My Arm's Big Adventure, and unlock at Livid Farm rewards

Travelling from Fremennik Province
• Teleport to the entrance to Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, for example fairy ring AJR, ring of slaying, Fremennik Province lodestone.
• Equip climbing boots to climb the [[Rocks (Death Plateau)

Travelling from Burthorpe
• Teleport to Burthorpe lodestone.
• Equip climbing boots (obtain them from Freda if the player does not have them). Also requires 41 Agility for cliffside.
• Follow the route to get to the dungeon. This route may take damage from Thrower Trolls around [[Death Plateau (location)

get_inside.text: Feldip Hills
Possible options to reach Oo'glog include:
Use the Master archaeologist's outfit to teleport to Chief Tess directly inside Oo'glog (requires Archaeology Guildmaster Qualification)
Teleport to the Oo'glog lodestone to arrive north outside its walls

Travel by Charter ship (requires completion of As a First Resort) from a relevant dock elsewhere. The charter trip costs up to 5,000 coins depending upon the port of departure. The price can be halved twice if the player has done the Cabin Fever quest and is wearing a Ring of charos (a).

Use the Volcanic trapper outfit (with 39 Hunter) teleport to Wimpy bird hunting area, just outside the entrance of Oo'glog. The teleport option is accessed by selecting the right-click option 'teleport' on the head while wearing the outfit, then 'bird snaring' in the susequent menu.
Players with 57 Summoning may use a Spirit Larupia to teleport to the Feldip Hills hunter area just north of Oo'glog.

Teleport to the Warforge Dig Site - either via a Spirit tree, a Ring of duelling, the South Feldip Hills Teleport in the regular spellbook, or the Archaeology fast travel table in the Archaeology Campus (requires 76 Archaeology) - and run east to Oo'glog from there. There are many medium-level monsters between the centre and Oo'glog, but Protect from Melee can be used to avoid all damage with prayer points then being recharged at the spa's sulphur spring.

The Eagle transport system can be used to reach the jungle hunter area north of Oo'glog. Players with 29 Agility may also use the shortcut on the north wall to avoid the various aggressive creatures near the west entrance.

place.title: Marim
place.summary: Marim is a village on Ape Atoll, inhabited by various monkeys who are ruled over by King Awowogei. It is only accessible to players who have partially or fully completed the Monkey Madness quest, and most of the quest takes place there. The village is most likely named after Marimbo, the monkey god. There are various shops and stalls around the village, including one of the only two places that sell dragon scimitars, the other one being Dealga's Scimitar Emporium in Varrock. At the south of Marim is the Ape Atoll Agility Course, which can only be used in ninja monkey form.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

ml.name: Dragonkin Laboratory
ml.text: Onyx dragons are enemies encountered in the Dragonkin Laboratory. Like most dragons, they are susceptible to the Dragon Slayer perk and dragonbane ammunition. A method of protection from dragonfire is highly recommended against them. Like other onyx dragons, they will periodically use a special attack which steals some of the player's life points and heals the dragon for 5,000 life points. The attack is signified by black spikes moving towards the player's location. When the spikes reach their destination, they erupt in a 3 by 3 area of effect (AoE). Moving out of this area before the spikes erupt negates the effect of this attack. They will only use this special attack against targets outside of their melee range.

Teleports

Quick methods to teleport across the island are ():
• Anachronia lodestone, which can be unlocked using materials after completing a tutorial with Giles at the base camp
• Slayer cape to teleport to Laniakea's at the south-east ruins
• North-western Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the north-western side of Anachronia, near the time altar
• Eastern Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the eastern side of Anachronia, a short distance to the east of the spirit grove

• Anachronia tablet to teleport to the Player Lodge; it requires the Love Story quest and a tier 2 Player Lodge
• Ancient seed to Herby Werby

• Dig sites map, master archaeologist's outfit or Archaeology teleport to Orthen Dig Site (or to Sharrigan) with 90 Archaeology
• Archaeology journal then run east to the Stormbreaker ship

Orthen teleportation device

Players with at least level 90 Archaeology can unlock the Orthen Dig Site and activate the Orthen teleportation devices, allowing them to teleport to four locations across the island:
• Crypt of Varanus, located near the arcane apoterrasaur hunting area
• Observation outpost, located north of the pavosaurus rex hunting area
• Moksha ritual site, located just east of the scimitops hunting area
• Xolo city, located within the Anachronia Swamp Fortress on the south-eastern tip of the island

get_inside.text: The player will not be able to enter Iban's Temple and the elven lands until the player has spoken to King Lathas at the start of Regicide. The player's quest journal will mention about assassinating his brother if they have talked to him.
Travelling through Underground path
To go through the path, it is recommended to have a high Agility level. A Thieving level of 50 is another advantage.
These items are needed:
A rope (bring more if the Agility level is low)
A shortbow (chargebow will not work)
A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows (bring a few extras should you do so; no advantage in type)
Food to survive traps and monsters
Part 1
Checklist | * Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.

Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
Go to the north.
Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level #expr:42*2 Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
Continue going south, then east.

Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.

You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.
Pathmap | 5 | 5 | id=Underground Pass
Once past the spike traps, pull the [[Lever (Underground path, portcullis)
Part 2
Head west towards the [[Cage (Underground path, slave)
Part 3
Go past the smashed cage and pass through the [[Tunnel (Underground Pass)
Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair
After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave.
Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step.
After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins.
Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
Ascend the stairs.
If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
Heading south, cross the third walkway.
Jump over the [[Bridge (Iban's lair)

getting_there.heading: Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair
getting_there.text:
• After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
• Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).

• Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step.

• Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
• Ascend the stairs.

place.title: Zanaris
place.summary: According to the co-ordinator, Zanaris is 'an extremely old place, it was here long before we fairyfolk came to live here' with many dormant magical properties, such as those of 'the ability to jump between planes using a powerful portal' that had been sealed for centuries, but the Fairy Queen harnessed the magic and used it to create the network of fairy rings, though not as powerful as the portal, the World Gate, would have been. This property of being a nexus of planes places it under threat from other realms. In the late Fifth Age, it was invaded by orks from Ork's Rift, but not without help of the malicious Fairy Mafia. Conversely, Zanaris is famous for its market, where various items from other worlds are sold, an example being a selection of dragon weapons from Freneskae supplied by the Consortium of Extra-Planar Merchandise Transferral Specialists.
